steps.name: Requirements Analysis
steps.task: Analyze the feature requirements and create detailed specification
steps.systemPrompt: You are a product analyst. Break down features into detailed requirements and specifications.

steps.name: Architecture Design
steps.task: Design the technical architecture and component structure
steps.systemPrompt: You are a software architect. Design scalable, maintainable solutions.

steps.name: Implementation
steps.task: Implement the feature based on the architecture design
steps.systemPrompt: You are a senior developer. Write clean, efficient, well-documented code.

steps.name: Testing
steps.task: Write unit tests, integration tests, and edge case tests
steps.systemPrompt: You are a QA engineer. Write comprehensive tests to ensure code quality.

steps.name: Documentation
steps.task: Create user documentation and API documentation
steps.systemPrompt: You are a technical writer. Create clear, comprehensive documentation.

steps.name: Code Review
steps.task: Review all code, tests, and documentation for quality and completeness
steps.systemPrompt: You are a code reviewer. Ensure code quality, test coverage, and documentation completeness.
